units: <cite ref="Shabbat 25b:6">Sabb. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>איזהו ע׳ כל שיש לו נחת רוח בעשרו</he> who is rich? He who finds satisfaction in his wealth; <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 4:1">Ab. IV, 1</cite>; <cite ref="Tamid 32a:37">Tam. 32ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 2:15">Deut. R. s. 2</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 18:23">Prov. XVIII, 23</cite>) <he>עֲשִׁירוֹ של עולם</he> the rich One (Owner) of the world.
<cite ref="Proverbs 18:23">Ib.</cite> <he>אדם אם יהא לו קרוב ע׳ וכ׳</he> if a man’s relative is rich, he owns him, and if poor, he disowns him.
<cite ref="Pesachim 113a:13">Pes. 113ᵃ</cite> <he>ע׳ המעשר וכ׳</he> a rich man who gives away the tenth portion of his income in secret.

<cite ref="Pesachim 113b:10">Ib. 113ᵇ</cite> (four are unbearable) <he>דל גאה וע׳ פכחש וכ׳</he> a poor man that is proud, a rich man that flatters &c.; a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>עֵשִׁירִים</he>, <he>עְשִׁירִין</he>.

<cite ref="Eruvin 86a:2">Erub. 86ᵃ</cite> <he>רבי מכבד ע׳</he> Rabbi paid honor to the rich (for the sake of their charitable mission, ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 61:8">Ps. LXI, 8</cite>, v. <cite ref="J00675"><he>יָשַׁב</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Yoma 35b:4-13">Yoma 35ᵇ</cite> <he>רבי … מחייב את הע׳</he> the example of R. El. b. Ḥarsum condemns the rich (who neglect the law on account of their business occupations).
Men. 86ᵃ, a. e. וסימניך ע׳ מקמצין and thy mnemonical sign (v. סִימָן) be: the rich are economical (Rabbi favored the economical practice); a. fr.—Fem. עֲשִׁירָה.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 3:3:3">Y. Shek. III, end, 47ᶜ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Shekalim 2:4">Tosef. Shek. II, 4</cite>; a. e.—Pl. <cite ref="P01485"><he>עֲשִׁירוֹת</he></cite>. Tanḥ. Toldôth 9 <he>ע׳ הן נאות וכ׳</he> they are rich, they are handsome &c.
